prompt:
Create a transparent-background pixel-art atlas with exactly TWO equal square cells side-by-side, first TOP and second BOTTOM, for the exact object shown in the canonical source. The labeled reference shows source and only accepted elevations/planes; source identity/material is authoritative. True orthographic principal views only, no isometric or perspective.

TOP: The mast carries a vertical signal stack with red upper/light and green lower/light aligned on one pole. From +Z these are stacked along Z and must overlap in plan: show the upper red signal housing as the visible top cap, with only its centered pole footprint; do not place the red and green signal lamps side by side. Include the offset ladder/guard footprint as a narrow adjacent edge aligned to the existing front and side views. BOTTOM: full same XY footprint, looking straight up; show the pole/base end and the ladder’s full offset footprint/underside, not just a tiny centered post. Do not show the vertical signal faces from below, no broad upright panels. Keep the same orientation and dimensions as accepted side views.
Center both isolated views with generous transparent margins. No labels, shadows, detached guide marks, clipping, or extra objects. Crisp clustered pixel art.
